script.title: Special Delivery: the Pedalling Pelican
script.description: A white pelican pedals a red seaside bicycle, gripping the handlebars with black-tipped wings. A long yellow bill and deep orange throat pouch dominate its silhouette. Webbed feet ride opposite pedals, a blue scarf streams backwards, and a rear basket carries the morning catch. Compact clear supports carry the display.
